verifier: migration-reviewer (opus/high), harness-update review round 1; summarized by the orchestrator from the reviewer's hand-back report (the reviewer role is read-only and cannot write files)

blocking.issue: Not a valid A1 C8 proof for page URLs: it compares only two /api/blog bodies, never the page/text/sitemap diff an allowlist entry would cover, so other real changes captured alongside would be allowlisted with it. '/' and /llms*.txt run their own queries. The absolute top-N boundary check fails on live data (A vs A, topN=4) because lib/storage.ts prepends the fallback article claude-commerce-agents-b2b.
blocking.fix: Work on each page's own raw bodies (ordered slug sequences), use one created_at map from A, require the residual text to be byte-identical after tie-group reordering, use a relative top-N test that accounts for the fallback post, and add real-data self-test cases (A vs A passes; A vs A plus one text edit fails).

nonBlocking: tie-permutation: ignores published:false items and compares Sets instead of multisets; --top-n NaN is silently skipped; created_at ties are ms-level

urls.mjs 1c (sitemap-b) cannot send the protection-bypass header, so it would get a 401 at P5.2 (fails loudly); 1b/1c are recorded before the expect-bearing sources (could shadow counts or expect blocks)
compare.mjs: full/full isn't byte-identical to before (the missing-slug diff now pins sha256, an improvement; additive keys); the jsonBySlug.<slugs> diff format differs between paths (fails closed)
compare.mjs: a compact text/plain side falls back to 300-char previews instead of the raw-dir body (fails closed)
selftest: no mixed-mode mutation cases; the real --compact capture path isn't in the self-test
functional --expect-cache-hit passes on HIT regardless of status (a cached 404 would pass)
C10 threshold is 3.5 MiB, not 3.5 MB; size and array length are emitted only above the threshold
SPEC-04 §3/§4 don't describe compact mode, the size warning or the tie checker (the orchestrator fixed the spec text in the same commit as this file)
